title: How much water the East Australian Current carries, and why estimates differ
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), estimate the transport of the East Australian Current in several defensible ways, differing in latitude, depth limit, the definition of the current's edges and the treatment of recirculation and eddies. Quantify how far the estimates differ and determine which choices account for most of the difference.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
